name: Federated States of Micronesia
summary: Succession is governed by each of the four states (Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei, Yap) with custom, not by one national law. No fixed heirship share was found. Trust and foundation law and Hague status are not confirmed.
family_claims: Not found. Each state's code applies; a state probate court cannot reach property in another state (FSM Supreme Court 2018).
foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule sourced; state law governs.
trust_note: No national or state trust statute was found; 'limited' is recorded pending confirmation. No foundation law found.
open_questions: State probate and wills laws in all four states.
The HCCH table as retrieved shows no entry for this jurisdiction (the retrieved copy was marked last updated 2017 and its territorial-extension notes could not be read); re-check the live table.
Trust/foundation availability marked unclear: no statute was found, which does not show that none exists.
